title: Monitoring of dual-drug combination therapy in pediatric epilepsy patients: a machine learning model for simultaneous VPA-LEV concentration-dose prediction.
summary: The abstract reports retrospective pediatric epilepsy concentration adequacy and individualized VPA/LEV dose predictions from 497 paired samples; this is a specific drug-monitoring application, without prospective utility evidence.
ai_technology: Dual-predictive machine-learning model for concentration adequacy and dose regression
organization: Affiliation not stated in the reviewed material

evidence.tested: The retrospective dataset contained 497 paired concentration samples from 402 pediatric epilepsy patients; classification models predicted concentration adequacy and regression models recommended daily doses.
evidence.unknown: The retrospective concentration samples do not establish prospective dosing impact or improved patient outcomes.
evidence.ai_role: Classifies VPA/LEV concentration adequacy and regresses individualized daily doses from paired concentration samples.

source_review.scope: Primary result-bearing material for the stated method, result and evaluation, with bibliographic version information.
